delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" apa udi umvuija anu ne: serveur udibu basue kuenza nende mudimu mmupingaje tshitupa tshia HTTP 2xx - kawena ujadika ne: systeme udi wangata bintu mmulame anyi muenze mudimu ne tshintu tshidiye mulongolole to. Tangila tshitupa tshia diandamuna tshidi kulu eku bua kumanya tshiditshi tshiamba; Shi i munda mutupu nansha anu dianyisha, tshiamu etshi tshidi mua kuikala tshipeta dilomba kadi tshibenga anyi tshilengulula bujitu bua mudimu munda (mêna a miaba/mushindu mubi wa API wende, muaba udibu balomba ku luseke luende udi bujitu ebu kabuyi bubueja, ne bikuabu).

push.title: Webhooks ya kupatuka - Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Bionso bidi mua kulongolola bilondeshile webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), anyi tshilejelu tshieba tshia mubidi tshidi ne <fieldkey></fieldkey> placeholders (e.g. <example></example> ) - tshidi tshienza mudimu anu bu kuwuja dîyi dia cURL musangu umua.
push.curlLabel: Lama cURL wa CRM wa muena mudimu webe
push.curlHelp: Lama tshilejilu tshia dilomba dia mikanda yabu API anyi Postman idi ikupesha (ne malu malelela anyi a tshilejilu). URL , mushindu ne mitu ya malu bidi bifunda anu mudibi, ne tshifungu tshionso tshidi mu mubidi tshidi tshifunda kuinshi eku bua wewe kusungula tshitupa tshia CRM tshidi tshiwuja bua tshintu tshionso tshidi tshilombola.
push.curlPrompt: Udi ne cURL wa muena mudimu anyi ? <action>Lumbusha ku cURL</action> bua kuwuja ne kulongolola miaba nkayayi.
push.urlVariables: URL udi mua kuikala kabidi ne bintu bishilangane, tshilejilu <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Mitu ya malu idi ne tshia kuikala JSON mimpe, tshilejilu {{example}}
push.authTitle: Dijadika (mushindu udi Leadrat ubuela mu API wabu)

push.modeCreateUpdate: Enza tshikandakanda musangu umua, pashishe ushintulule tshikandakanda atshi (kakuyi tshidi tshipingana ku luseke luabu to)

push.responseIdOptional: ID wabu wa difunda mu diandamuna (pa kusungula)
push.responseIdHint: Muaba udi ID mu diandamuna diabu JSON ku dilomba dia kuenza. Mulamibue ku muntu yonso bu <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Bua bikondo bia ndekelu, bilema bia HTTP 429 ne 5xx - kunyima kua 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.updateBody: Kulongolola mubidi (mutupu = bia muomumue ne kuenza)
push.howFilled: Mushindu udi mishinga miuja: webhook eu udi wenza mudimu kabidi bua muntu yonso udi ulombola - Leadrat kena utuma tshilejilu tshidi katshiyi tshishintuluka to, udi utuma dituma dipiadipia dîba dionso didi bualu kampanda busungula buenzeka, ne mishinga ya mpindieu ya muntu au.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Form udi ubueja tshitupa tshionso tshia kumpala - kakuena tshia kuenza to.
push.howFilledCustom: Pa tshibidilu - funda tshitupa tshieba tshia dilomba ne wela muaba wonso; tshionso tshidi tshishintakaja ne mushinga mulelela wa tshintu atshi kumpala kua kutuma. Fina pa tshintu tshidi kuinshi eku bua kutshibueja.

receive.title: Itaba - Itaba bantu badi mua kukulombola mu mushindu kayi wonso
receive.intro: Muaba wonso udi ne URL wende. Leja mamanyisha a Facebook , Zapier , formilere wa kazubu ka tanda ya internet anyi webhook mukuabu wa CRM - badi batuma bantu badi mua kukulombola mu mushindu wabu JSON anyi wa formilere, ne udi ufunda miaba yabu ku yebe.

api.title: API webe - Njila ibidi ya kubuela mu tshiamu tshionso
api.intro: Tshiamu tshionso tshidi ne tshifungu tshieba API tshidi mua kuenza, kubala ne kulengeja bantu badi mua kukulombola ne kudifundisha ku malu adibu bafila. Tuma tshifungu mu mutu wa <hdr></hdr> , bu <bearer></bearer> , anyi (bikala tshiamu katshiyi mua kuteka mitu) bu <query></query> . Tshipiminu: {{limit}} tshia dilomba ku minite.
api.noPermission: Anu muntu udi ne bukenji bua kulombola malu ke udi mua kumona tshifungu tshia API .
api.shownOnce: Kopa tshifungu etshi mpindieu ne utshilame muaba muimpe - bua bukubi tshidi tshileja anu musangu umua. Shi tshijimine, enza tshipiatshipia.
api.regenerateConfirm: Kuenza tshifungu tshipiatshipia API anyi? Tshifungu tshia mpindieu tshidi tshilekela mudimu diakamue bua tshiamu tshionso tshidi tshienza natshi mudimu.
api.openApiHint: Bueja OpenAPI spec mu Postman , Zapier , Make anyi n8n bua kupeta endpoint yonso milongolola bua kuenza nayi mudimu.
